points.text: 1 structural difference E. turcicum: chitin cell wall or no chloroplasts or hyphae / cells long and branching or syncytial / multinucleate / several nuclei per cell ; Z. mays: cellulose cell wall or chloroplasts or no hyphae / cells not long and branching or one nucleus per cell ;
2 functional difference E. turcicum: heterotroph(ic) / parasitic / obtain food from host / do not photosynthesise ; Z. mays: autotroph(ic) / phototrophic / photosynthesis(e) ;
